text:
Marta Velez: Endgame check-in for this cycle  two days left. Managers: submit handbacks + reviewer forms by Friday 11:59pm PST. If you have a documented accommodation (LOA, parental, jury duty), reply here and well mark an exception.

Evan Carter: Quick Q  my org has 11 directs. Can I split calibration across two live sessions?

Marta Velez: Yes, split into ~6 and ~5. Mark Group A / B in the calibration template header so scheduling is easier.

Lina Zhou: CSV uploader header? Ive seen `proxy` vs `proxy_reviewer` used. Which is canonical?

Marta Velez: Canonical header: `email,manager,handback_date,proxy_reviewer,notes,preferred_slot`. Use ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD).

people-ops-bot: Reminder: 48h to deadline. Evan has 11 items pending. :bell:

Evan Carter: Example CSV OK here?

Marta Velez: Yep please paste a small snippet if youre unsure. Example:
```
email,manager,handback_date,proxy_reviewer,notes,preferred_slot
sam@redwood.com,evan@redwood.com,2025-06-20,lina@redwood.com,"prefers afternoon",PM
```

Lina Zhou: If a manager is the only reviewer and becomes unavailable, will people-ops auto-assign?

Marta Velez: We escalate to the managers lead if no proxy exists. Best practice: add a proxy in the form or notify us before Noon Thu.

HR Ops: Note: confidential promotion cases  set `confidential: yes` in the template and add a one-line reason. Well create a redacted packet and schedule a private block with HR.

Evan Carter: Can we request AM/PM blocks?

Marta Velez: Add `preferred_slot` (AM/PM) in your CSV/template. We will try to honor preferences but cant guarantee.

Lina Zhou: Thanks  uploading split CSVs now.

Marta Velez: Great. If anyone hits upload errors, paste 5 lines here and well help. Final provisional calibration calendar posted by EOD tomorrow. :calendar:
